SCI-specific classify_fn for use with run_cohort_info()

Source: R/cohort_info.R
scid_classify.Rd

Reference implementation of a classify_fn for spinal cord injury research. Adds SCI classification (traumatic/non-traumatic, top/second level), injury cause summary, procedure summary, and hos_eth_flg to cohort_info.

Usage

scid_classify(
  diag_exp,
  con,
  raw_schema,
  src_name,
  group_col,
  icds_scid_path = NULL,
  icds_cause_path = NULL,
  icds_proc_path = NULL,
  icds_proc_dict_path = NULL,
  publish = TRUE
)

Arguments

diag_exp

Expanded diagnostic data frame built by the generic builder.

con

DBI connection.

raw_schema

Raw Postgres schema name.

src_name

Source name (e.g. "mimic_iv_demo").

group_col

Visit grouping column (e.g. "hadm_id", "patienthealthsystemstayid").

icds_scid_path

Path to the canonical SCI ICD classification (RDS or CSV). Defaults to the package-embedded scid_icds_rendehr.rds.

icds_cause_path

Path to injury cause/etiology CSV. Defaults to package-embedded file.

icds_proc_path

Path to SCI procedure classification CSV. Optional. When supplied, MIMIC sources also gain procedure columns and the d_scid_operation_procedures_icds_rendehr reference table. eICU has no ICD-coded procedure table, so it reports proc_classification_status = "not_reported" and typed-NA procedure columns regardless.

icds_proc_dict_path

Path to ICD procedure description CSV. Optional.

publish

Whether to publish the procedure dictionary to raw_schema. Set FALSE when the caller defers publication of its clinical tables, so a compute-only call does not write to the database.

Value

Data frame keyed by group_col with SCI enrichment columns.

The SCI categories use the dictionary's is_sci (1 spinal cord, 3 cord symptoms, 999 possible cord, 2 nerve root, 0 spinal control) and is_tr (1 traumatic, 0 non-traumatic, 2 unspecified):

  • top_level: "Spinal cord damage" if any code is is_sci 1, 3 or 999; else "Nerve roots injury and disease" if any is 2; else "Spinal control".

  • second_level: for SCI stays, decided from the SCI codes only - "Traumatic SCI" if any is traumatic, else "Non-traumatic SCI" if any is non-traumatic, else "Unspecified SCI". Nerve-root stays are "Nerve root injury and disease". Control stays are "Spinal trauma control" if any code is traumatic, else "Spinal non-trauma control".

  • scid_trauma_types: trauma statuses of the SCI codes, joined with | (e.g. "non_traumatic|traumatic"); NA for non-SCI stays.

  • scid_nontrauma_l1, scid_nontrauma_l2: etiology of the SCI codes for non-traumatic SCI, joined with " | "; "not_applicable" otherwise.

Details

Pass this as classify_fn to run_cohort_info(), with classify_args supplying the file paths. All paths default to the package-embedded SCI files.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# used as the classify_fn of the SCI cohort annotations
build_cohort_annotations("mimic_iv_demo", db_name = "rendehr", classify_fn = scid_classify)
} # }
